### Dark theme (JD Plain Dark) visibility fixes

- **The LinkGrabber panel menu now shows which options are on.** In the LinkGrabber, the "Customize this Bottom Panel" menu (Package or Link Properties, Overview Panel visible, Sidebar visible, Autostart Download and the others) gave no sign of which entries were active, so a toggle looked the same whether it was on or off. Each active entry now carries a small light check badge, so its on and off state is clear at a glance. Entries that ship no icon of their own get one too.
- **The Download Overview panel corner icons are visible again.** The settings (wrench) and close (X) icons in the top corner of the Download Overview panel were a near-invisible dark grey on the dark theme. They are now drawn in light grey, so they read clearly like the panel's other icons.
